changelog:
- Initial release of Google Calendar Update Summary skill.
- Allows updating only the summary (title) of an existing Google Calendar event via CLI.
- Strictly limited to the summary field; does not change event times, locations, or attendees.
- Integrates error-checking and retry logic to ensure summary is updated correctly.
- Provides clear CLI usage example and expected output format.
summary: Atomic node skill to exclusively update the summary (title) of a Google Calendar event.
